title: Set Asset Folder Access Request
description: Apply who sees and/or who manages to every asset in a folder and all its subfolders, once. A present key replaces that set on each asset; an absent key leaves it. Nothing is stored on the folder.

group_ids.description: Groups that may view the assets; an empty list makes them public

role_ids.description: Roles that manage the assets; an empty list (or only the admin role) is for an admin only. The admin role is implicit and never stored.
